fields.name: num
fields.coerce: none: used as an array key, so `"5"` also works. Any other value reads an empty slot

responses.name: Success, compound item
responses.when: The item is a compound item at level 1 or more, and all checks pass. The server takes the gold, removes the item and adds three copies at `level - 1`. Each copy gets `parseInt(grace / 3)` grace.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The level of the item before the dismantle. The copies have `level - 1`.

fields.name: cost
fields.description: The gold paid: `min(50000000, calculate_item_value(item) * 10)`. `calculate_item_value` rounds, so it is an integer.

fields.name: cevent
fields.description: Tells the official client to fire its `dismantle` code event.

confirm.note: This branch does not check the lock `l` or the flag `b`

responses.name: Success, recipe
responses.when: Any other item with a `G.dismantle` recipe, and all checks pass. The server takes `G.dismantle[name].cost` gold, removes one item and adds the outputs. An output `[c, name]` with `c` below 1 is a chance; else `c` is the quantity. A title `p` of the item that is not a `misc` title goes to each output.

fields.name: cevent
fields.description: Tells the official client to fire its `dismantle` code event.

rows.when: No character, or the character is in the bank.
You are more than `B.sell_dist` (400 px) from the `craftsman` NPC on `main`. A character with a `computer` passes this check.
Compound item (level 1 or more, `G.items[name].compound`): your gold is less than the cost.
Compound item: fewer than 2 empty inventory slots (`esize < 2`).
Compound item: the item is of type `booster`.
Other item: the slot is empty, or `G.dismantle` has no recipe for the item.
Other item: the item has the lock `l`.
Other item: the item has the flag `b`.
Other item: your gold is less than `G.dismantle[name].cost`.
Other item: the outputs do not fit (`can_add_items`). A single item (`q` 1) counts its own slot as free.

also.when: Recipe success, for each rare output (see `ItemAnnouncement`). The compound path adds its copies with `announce: false` and sends none.

example.message: Wizard received an Essence of Fire
example.name: Wizard

confirm.note: `add_item` announces when the item is rare (`G.items[name].a`); the compound branch passes `announce: false` (6469)

also.summary: Your state with `reopen: true`. `items`, `esize` and `gold` show the dismantle.

order: `server_message` to everyone, only for a rare output of a recipe
